method.commit_match: blob: the target's git blob is in a maple-labs repository and the chosen commit holds the most of the set's files; unit: a flattened target's contract, library and interface units equal, after CRLF to LF and trailing-whitespace removal, the units of an indexed file version, and the chosen commit holds the most units; nearest: no version equals the target unit, and the version with the fewest differing lines is recorded with those lines; closest: the target blob is in no repository and the commit holding the most set files is recorded. The chosen commit is the earliest equivalent commit carrying a tag, else the latest
method.creation_blocks: eth_getCode is empty at block b-1 and non-empty at block b; the transaction is Blockscout's creation transaction, or, for the 58 contracts it names none for, the block's only transaction whose logs are emitted by or name the address
method.epochs: InstanceDeployed opens a factory instance's first epoch and each InstanceUpgraded the next; ImplementationRegistered maps a version to its implementation; a non-factory proxy's epochs are its EIP-1967 slot history found by bisection; each proxy's last epoch equals its slot at the pinned block
method.solc_reproduction: the verified input with outputSelection narrowed to the target's deployedBytecode, linkReferences and immutableReferences, compiled by the solc linux-amd64 build of its version; libraries linked from the verifier's record, else from the address the chain's code carries at every link site, which must be a subject; immutable ranges and a library's own address zeroed on both sides before comparison with eth_getCode at the pinned block. exact: equal; sans-cbor: equal once the trailing CBOR metadata is removed from both; sans-embedded-cbor: every differing byte lies in a CBOR metadata blob at the same offset in both, as in a factory that carries its child's creation code
method.source_sets: one compilation: target, compiler, settings and the git blob of every source file, from Blockscout's verified record, else Sourcify's; a subject without its own record joins the set whose compiled runtime equals its code
method.subject_set: the sizing seed's v1, v2-core, v2-fixed-term and v2-open-term tiers, closed over factory() answers, every Maple proxy factory's ImplementationRegistered, UpgradePathEnabled and InstanceDeployed logs, the V2 globals' ValidInstanceSet logs (a key ending _FACTORY marks a factory) and each non-factory proxy's EIP-1967 slot history; an address the closure adds is a subject when Maple created it (a seed subject's creator or a Maple factory) or its source blobs are in a maple-labs repository, and is excluded, with its reason, when it holds no code or is another party's contract
